entities.name: Snapdax
entities.description: The All-Hunter, ferocious apex monster of the Savai triome on Ikoria that combines cat-like cleverness and dinosaur aggression.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who stumbled upon Snapdax's cavern of skulls and fled.

entities.name: Savai
entities.description: Triome on Ikoria where Snapdax is the apex monster.

entities.name: Monstrosaur
entities.description: Fast-moving creature that carried Vivien away from Snapdax.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: Sanctuary built by survivors of Snapdax's attacks.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane invaded by Snapdax and other behemoths.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Massive portal through which behemoths invaded Kamigawa.

events.summary: Vivien Reid stumbles upon Snapdax's cavern full of skulls while exploring the mesa of Savai.
events.quote: The planeswalker Vivien Reid stumbled upon the cavern full of skulls

events.summary: Vivien flees the waking Snapdax thanks to her fast-moving Monstrosaur.
events.quote: Vivien managed to flee from the rapidly waking Snapdax only thanks to her fast-moving Monstrosaur

events.summary: Legend says survivors of Snapdax's attacks joined forces and built Drannith.
events.quote: the survivors of the attacks joined forces to build a new sanctuary together

events.summary: Snapdax invades Kamigawa alongside other behemoths via a massive Omenpath.
events.quote: Snapdax invaded Kamigawa alongside other behemoths via a massive Omenpath

relations.note: It is the apex monster of the Savai triome.
relations.quote: is the apex monster of the Savai triome on Ikoria

relations.note: Vivien had to flee from it.
relations.quote: Vivien managed to flee from the rapidly waking Snapdax
